name: Rich
overview: Scripture reveals that true riches come as a blessing from the LORD, who enriches without adding sorrow (Proverbs 10:22). Jesus warns against storing up earthly treasures that are vulnerable to decay and theft, emphasizing that one cannot serve both God and wealth (Matthew 6:19, 24). The challenge of trusting in riches is highlighted as a significant barrier to entering the kingdom of God (Mark 10:24), illustrated by the story of the rich man who lived in luxury yet faced eternal consequences (Luke 16:19). Believers are encouraged to rely on God's provision rather than anxious pursuit of material needs (Matthew 6:31).
